Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1954); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite:--Osee.
BiblicalUsage: Hōsēé is the Greek form of Hosea, the prophet, and it stands in Romans 9:25, where Paul quotes Hosea: 'I will call them my people, which were not my people.' The life behind the name is told on the Hosea People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hosea matters because God knows His people by name, and Hosea is one of them.
